item.coloph: ston pa stag la me 'bar la/ bdag 'dra phung bon mgo dmar gyis/ lha nor bcu gsum phul nas zhus/ 'di'i mi zlog gang yang med/ spu gri nag po phung bon gyis zhus pa'i zlog chung 'di/ bla chen dran pa nyid la gtad/ bla chen dran pa nyid kyis kyang / mo (mdo) gam lha btsan gnas su gter du sbas/ phyi rabs dus kyi tha ma la/ ban btsun nang dme 'khrug pa byed/ mthu rgyas dug la re ba'i dus/ de dus bstan pa 'di yis 'dzin/ gser gyi nyi ma shar bar shog dung gi zla ba tshes par shog/
